notes:
Base Metric Group: Attack Vector, Attack Complexity, Privileges Required, User Interaction, Scope, Confidentiality/Integrity/Availability impact.
Temporal: Exploit Code Maturity, Remediation Level, Report Confidence.
Environmental: Modified base metrics + C/I/A requirements.
DREAD (Microsoft): Damage, Reproducibility, Exploitability, Affected users, Discoverability.
Calculator: nvd.nist.gov/vuln-metrics/cvss/v3-calculator

recommended.note: Use CVSS to prioritize which findings to exploit.

name: Reference - CVSS Scoring
description: CVSS metric groups used to score vulnerability severity, plus the DREAD alternative.
